_comment: The schedules of the 'explained Icinga alerts' tutorial flow. configure-explained-agents.ps1 writes each entry as a scheduler schedule (the name is the Icinga service name and the alias the agent records a failure under), setup-icinga-explained-alerts.ps1 defines a passive service per entry and derives the freshness window (2 x interval), and verify-icinga-explained.ps1 breaks the entry named by 'fault' and waits for its explained notification. host_check is the result of the host itself, not a service. A command is one string, or one per OS. Commands are written without quotes and spaces inside an argument: they pass through a PowerShell and a bash command line on the way to nsclient.ini.
